feat[marketplace]: replace sync/validate/lint scripts with marketplace CLI (v0.1.0)

A single uv-run tool (scripts/marketplace/) drives the registry: sync,
validate, lint, export, and a `check` merge-gate. Retire the three ad-hoc
scripts; rewire CI to `marketplace check` + pytest. Manifest regenerated to
14 plugins after the shared-marketplace merge.
